name: Living Shadow (Su)
body:
Benefit(s): A ninja with this talent can use her ki to blend into the background. For one minute per level, she may roll two dice while making a Stealth check and take the better result. Each use of this ability uses up 1 ki point.

Ultimate Options: Power of the Ninja © 2011, Rogue Genius Games, LLC; Author: Owen K.C. Stephens.
